## How this work is cited

Passages inside The Sickness unto Death are identified by part and section. Published under the pseudonym Anti-Climacus. Kierkegaard's pseudonyms are not disguises but positions, and the authorship is part of the argument — so 'Kierkegaard says' flattens a distinction he constructed deliberately.

## The work in Søren Kierkegaard’s thought

Søren Kierkegaard (1813–1855) was a Danish religious author and critic of Christendom who wrote under pseudonyms exploring aesthetic, ethical, and religious existence. Inheriting a melancholy family fortune, he attacked Hegelian system and lukewarm official faith in Copenhagen. [More on Søren Kierkegaard](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/soren-kierkegaard) .
